title: Molecular Docking and in silico Pharmacological Screening of Oleosin from Cocos Nucifera Complexed with Tamoxifen in Developing Potential Breast Chemotherapeutic Leads.
authors: Dela Cruz, Janeea Myles D; Dones, Sophia Allison A; Villanueva, Rianne C; Labrador, Alexis M; Santiago-Bautista, Myla R
journal: Asian Pacific journal of cancer prevention : APJCP
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和同源建模分析椰油油体蛋白Oleosin与他莫昔芬的相互作用，属于蛋白质-小分子药物结合，而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法创新，与本课题TF-DNA互作研究关联度低。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Tamoxifen is a widely used drug for breast cancer therapy; however, concerns and controversies regarding its efficiency arise as it induces various side effects, including endometrial cancer. This study aimed to assess the application of Oleosin as a potential protein carrier of Tamoxifen by evaluating the pharmacokinetic and pharmacological properties of Tamoxifen and determining its intermolecular interactions with Oleosin through in silico techniques. METHODS: The pharmacokinetic and pharmacological properties of Tamoxifen were assessed by using predictive applications such as SwissADME, PaccMann, and Way2Drug. On the other hand, Oleosin does not have a crystal structure in PDB. Thus, homology modeling was done through SWISS-MODEL to obtain a structure. The interactions between Oleosin (Accession no.: AZZ09171.1) and Tamoxifen (PubChem ID: 2733526) were studied by performing molecular docking using AutoDock4 to determine their feasibility as breast cancer drug combinations. RESULT: The chosen structure of Oleosin from the homology modeling resulted in an RMSD of 1.80A. Tamoxifen was predicted to have the highest activity in MCF7 cell lines, direct interaction with cytochrome enzymes, mediated interaction with estrogen receptors and tyrosine-protein kinase FYN, and low toxicity hazards based on the acute rat toxicity assay. It has lowest binding affinity of -5.26 kcal/mol. The hydrophobic (Ala106, Leu77, Ile80, Val84, and Tyr81) and electrically charged (Lys107 and Asp108) amino acids were critical in binding in the Oleosin-Tamoxifen-complex. Heatmap revealed that phenyl, ether, amine, and alkenyl are the functional groups involved in the receptor-ligand interactions. CONCLUSION: The application of Oleosin as a potential drug carrier was demonstrated by assessing the intermolecular interactions between the Tamoxifen and Oleosin through molecular docking. The properties of Tamoxifen revealed that the molecular targets impact the efficiency and the mechanism of action of the drug. This can also be the basis for investigating and determining the serious adverse effects induced by the drug.
abstract_zh: 目的：他莫昔芬是一种广泛用于乳腺癌治疗的药物；然而，由于其诱导包括子宫内膜癌在内的多种副作用，其疗效引发关注和争议。本研究旨在通过评估他莫昔芬的药代动力学和药理学特性，并利用计算机模拟技术确定其与油质蛋白（Oleosin）的分子间相互作用，来评估油质蛋白作为他莫昔芬潜在蛋白载体的应用。方法：使用SwissADME、PaccMann和Way2Drug等预测应用程序评估他莫昔芬的药代动力学和药理学特性。另一方面，油质蛋白在PDB中没有晶体结构，因此通过SWISS-MODEL进行同源建模以获得结构。通过使用AutoDock4进行分子对接，研究油质蛋白（登录号：AZZ09171.1）与他莫昔芬（PubChem ID：2733526）之间的相互作用，以确定其作为乳腺癌药物组合的可行性。结果：同源建模选定的油质蛋白结构RMSD为1.80Å。预测他莫昔芬在MCF7细胞系中活性最高，与细胞色素酶直接相互作用，与雌激素受体和酪氨酸蛋白激酶FYN介导相互作用，且基于急性大鼠毒性试验，其毒性危害较低。其最低结合亲和力为-5.26 kcal/mol。疏水性氨基酸（Ala106、Leu77、Ile80、Val84和Tyr81）和带电氨基酸（Lys107和Asp108）在油质蛋白-他莫昔芬复合物的结合中至关重要。热图显示，苯基、醚、胺和烯基是参与受体-配体相互作用的官能团。结论：通过分子对接评估他莫昔芬与油质蛋白之间的分子间相互作用，证明了油质蛋白作为潜在药物载体的应用。他莫昔芬的特性表明，分子靶点影响药物的疗效和作用机制，这也可作为研究和确定该药物诱导的严重不良反应的基础。
